method: Actual DesktopDownloadManager, DesktopDownloads and DesktopActivitySummary mounted together in React/jsdom with an empty native queue and fake timers for 60 seconds; native invoke/listen calls counted before and after migration.
regressions: Concurrent reads coalesce; stale reads cannot overwrite completed actions
Identical queue snapshots retain identity and do not redraw subscribers
Events arriving during a read schedule a bounded recheck
Failures preserve content and recover automatically
Resume switches to active fallback even when native events are absent
Hidden observation catches up immediately on visibility resume
Hidden command snapshots notify on resume even when the subsequent read is identical
Delayed Pause and Resume mutations preserve user order; rejected mutations do not block later controls
An open chooser does not block controls; successful selection reconciles with the current queue
Unsubscribed and delayed native listeners cannot resurrect unmounted stores
Chooser cancellation and failed UI observers cannot publish a false transfer
Manual panel dismissal remains suppressed until a new transfer session
limits: Deterministic local IPC/work counts, not installed native CPU, memory, FPS or public-network throughput measurements. Native schedulers and download ownership are unchanged.
